            n_ref_0 = n_ref_s - n_ref_1
            n_foc_1 = X_foc[foc_mask, item].sum()
            n_foc_0 = n_foc_s - n_foc_1
            
            A_sum += (n_ref_1 * n_foc_0) / N_s
            B_sum += (n_ref_0 * n_foc_1) / N_s
            
            # SE components (Breslow-Day)
            n_1_s = n_ref_1 + n_foc_1
            n_0_s = n_ref_0 + n_foc_0
            C_sum += (n_ref_s * n_foc_s * n_1_s * n_0_s) / (N_s ** 2 * (N_s - 1))
        
        if A_sum > 0 and B_sum > 0:
            alpha_mh[item] = A_sum / B_sum
            delta_mh[item] = -2.35 * np.log(alpha_mh[item])
            
            # SE of delta_mh
            se[item] = 2.35 * np.sqrt(C_sum) / np.sqrt(A_sum * B_sum) if C_sum > 0 else 999
            
            # Chi-squared test
            chi2_stat = (delta_mh[item] / se[item]) ** 2 if se[item] > 0 else 0
            p_values[item] = 1 - chi2.cdf(chi2_stat, 1)
    
    # ETS classification
    ets_c = (np.abs(delta_mh) >= 1.5) & (p_values < 0.05)
    return ets_c.mean() * 100  # C%
```
